providerMode: Local OpenAI-compatible stand-in (provider-standin.mjs) in its own container on this lab's backend network only; fictional paper and known answers; no real provider account or traffic.
browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium, headless, one context per identity at 1440x1000 CSS px

setup.text: Administrator API: AI connector saved as Custom, OpenAI chat completions, base URL http://analysis-provider:8080/v1 (the stand-in), model doc029-standin-model, and enabled. This is prerequisite preparation (configure-analysis), not a C21 step.

Administrator API: Contract type "DOC-029 analysis-standin Analysis type 1789572830220" with three prompted Fields (text location, number tier, text audit clause), and one live Counterparty "DOC-029 Analysis Supplier 1789572830220 Ltd" created on holder Contract C-72.
administrator API: created C-73 (no paper), C-74 (malformed primary PDF) and C-75 (main walk) of the analysis type; stand-in markers DOC029ASADMIN1789572830220 and DOC029ASADMIN1789572830220V2.
legal_team_member API: created C-77 (no paper), C-78 (malformed primary PDF) and C-79 (main walk) of the analysis type; stand-in markers DOC029ASLEGAL1789572830220 and DOC029ASLEGAL1789572830220V2.

administrator API: Contract C-83 with a download-only primary placeholder and four supporting Documents: Word v1 thirty/monthly, v2 sixty/quarterly, v3 ninety/annually; PDF v1 / Word v2; TXT v1 / PDF v2; malformed PDF v1 / PDF v2.

legal_team_member API: Contract C-84 with a download-only primary placeholder and four supporting Documents: Word v1 thirty/monthly, v2 sixty/quarterly, v3 ninety/annually; PDF v1 / Word v2; TXT v1 / PDF v2; malformed PDF v1 / PDF v2.

steps.step: Before you start: a Contract without a primary Document
steps.expected: The AI analysis card says no run has happened and Run analysis is refused with the no-primary-Document reason; no run is created.
steps.actual: C-73 Fields: AI analysis card below the Fields card read "No analysis has run yet.". Run analysis showed "This Contract has no primary Document to analyze."; the Contract still has no Analysis run.

steps.step: Before you start: the primary Document text failed to extract
steps.expected: No automatic run starts and Run analysis is refused because the target text is not ready or empty.
steps.actual: Uploaded a malformed PDF as C-74's primary Document (setup); its text state became "failed". Fields still read "No analysis has run yet." (no automatic run). Run analysis showed "The analysis target has no ready, non-empty text." and created no run.

steps.step: If the card is absent: disabled connector, no marked values and no run
steps.expected: With the connector disabled, the AI analysis card is absent on a Contract with no run and no markers, the Contract actions menu has no Run analysis, and a direct run is refused. Enabling brings the card back.
steps.actual: Administrator disabled the connector (setup API). C-73 Fields showed the Fields card and no AI analysis card; Contract actions offered ["Copy link","Rename contract","Archive"]; POST analysis answered 409 "No enabled AI connector is configured.".

steps.step: Run Analysis: an automatic run starts when the primary Document text becomes ready
steps.expected: The card says Running… with no Run analysis control, then updates in place to Completed … on Version 1 with the model; each result row shows the returned value, evidence and the documented outcome.
steps.actual: Uploaded the first PDF as C-75's primary Document (setup, stand-in paused). Fields showed "Running…" and no Run analysis control. After the stand-in answered, without a page load the card read "Completed Sep 16, 2026, 7:33 PM on Version 1 with doc029-standin-model.". Rows: "Expiry date Unverified Mar 31, 2027 This Agreement expires on March 31, 2027. steps.expected: A value typed but not yet saved on the Fields section stays in its control when the pending run completes and the card updates.

steps.step: Archiving keeps Comparisons readable and blocks new Generated redlines until restored
steps.expected: With the Document archived, Changes stay readable and no export is offered or accepted. With the owning Contract archived, the export is refused. After both are restored, the v2 → v3 export appends a Generated redline.
